recovery: Authored exact controls and pinned closure deterministically regenerate success. Failed nonlinear factor source is recovered by nonlinear-matching-coordinate-recovery.patch; original successful canonical graph source by canonical-matching-comment-recovery.patch. Both isolated recoveries are exact-SHA verified in final CI run.
omissions: Full510-candidate raw rows and secondary tied representatives are omitted from compact summaries; unchanged complete originals, sizes and hashes are explicitly recorded. Local ignored files are not promised in Git; complete gzip publication is separate.
